title: DigitallPower duplicate-rule configuration
description: Explicit publication state and ownership intent for existing Dataverse duplicate-detection rules. Rule definitions and conditions are not part of this format. Runtime validation also rejects duplicate rule IDs and duplicate JSON properties, which JSON Schema cannot express.

ruleId.description: The duplicateruleid of an existing rule, transported with a stable ID through solutions.

name.description: Informational rule name for reviews and diagnostics; never used for matching or written.

published.description: Requested publication state. Omit to leave the target state unchanged.

owner.description: Logical owner key resolved through the target environment owner mapping. Omit to leave ownership unchanged.
